Sign in Forgotten password Terms iMEdD is a non-profit organization founded in 2018 courtesy of an exclusive Stavros Niarchos Foundation (SNF) donation. Its mission is to support and promote transparency, credibility and independence in journalism, as means of securing meritocracy and excellence in the field. The Organization adheres to international standards and collaborates with the Greek and international academic community, as well as other international bodies and professionals in the field in order to implement programs, develop innovative ideas and produce original content. If you give your consent, iMEdD will use the personal data you provide through this form (name, surname and email address) to keep in touch with you about upcoming events. Your data will not be passed on to third parties – it will be used exclusively for dispatching iMEdD’s International Journalism Forum Newsletters. Once registered, you can withdraw your consent to the use of your personal data at any time by clicking on the unsubscribe link at the end of each email you receive from iMEdD or by email at [email protected]. For more information about subscribing to the newsletter, you can read Forum’s website Terms of Use as well as iMEdD’s Privacy Policy or contact iMEdD at [email protected].
